recipe_name_ar: مكرونة بشاميل
description: Traditional Egyptian baked pasta dish layered with seasoned minced meat and rich velvety béchamel sauce.
cooking_instructions: Boil penne pasta until al dente. Brown ground beef with diced onion, spices, and tomato paste. Prepare béchamel by cooking butter and flour, gradually adding warm milk until thickened. Layer half pasta, beef, rest of pasta, and top with béchamel. Bake at 200C for 35-40 mins until golden.

recipe_name_ar: كشري مصري
description: Egypt's national street food dish combining rice, brown lentils, macaroni, chickpeas, tangy tomato vinegar sauce, and crispy caramelized onions.
cooking_instructions: Cook brown lentils until tender. Cook short grain rice with vermicelli. Boil ditalini or elbow pasta. Deep fry thinly sliced onions until deep golden and crispy. Prepare tomato sauce with garlic, tomato paste, vinegar, and cumin. Prepare dakka vinegar-garlic dressing. Layer rice, lentils, pasta, chickpeas, spicy sauce, and top with fried onions.

recipe_name_ar: ملوخية بالفراخ
description: Finely minced fresh jute mallow leaves cooked in aromatic chicken broth and finished with the famous sizzled garlic and coriander ta'sha.
cooking_instructions: Boil whole chicken with onion, mastic, cardamom, and bay leaf until tender to make fragrant broth. Remove chicken and roast until golden. Heat 4 cups of strained broth and whisk in finely minced molokhia without boiling over. In a small pan, melt ghee, add crushed garlic and ground coriander until golden (the ta'sha), pour immediately into molokhia with a traditional gasp. Serve hot with Egyptian white rice.

recipe_name_ar: محشي مشكل
description: Zucchini, eggplants, bell peppers, and cabbage leaves stuffed with spiced herb-infused Egyptian short-grain rice and simmered in broth.
cooking_instructions: Core small zucchini and eggplants. Prepare filling: sauté onions in ghee and oil, add tomato sauce, cook down, mix with washed Egyptian rice, finely chopped fresh dill, parsley, cilantro, and spices. Stuff vegetables lightly to allow rice expansion. Arrange snugly in a heavy pot, pour seasoned broth halfway up, bring to boil, then simmer covered on low heat for 45-50 mins.

recipe_name_ar: فتة مصرية باللحمة والخل والثوم
description: Celebration feast dish made of crispy toasted baladi bread, fluffy white rice, and tender boiled beef bathed in a punchy garlic vinegar tomato sauce.
cooking_instructions: Boil beef cubes with aromatic spices until fork-tender. Cut baladi bread into squares, toss with ghee and bake until crisp. Cook Egyptian white rice in meat broth. Prepare garlic vinegar dressing by sautéing minced garlic in ghee, adding vinegar, broth, and tomato sauce. In a deep platter, layer toasted bread, moisten with garlic sauce, spread rice on top, ladle more sauce, and crown with browned beef pieces.

recipe_name_ar: حواوشي بلدي
description: Egyptian spiced minced beef patty packed inside fresh baladi pita pockets and baked until exterior is golden-crispy and interior juicy.
cooking_instructions: Knead minced beef with grated onions, minced bell pepper, hot green chili, fresh parsley, allspice, coriander, and black pepper. Slice open edge of fresh baladi pita pockets, stuff evenly with meat mixture. Brush pita exterior generously with melted ghee or oil. Wrap in parchment paper and bake at 200C for 20-25 mins flipping once until crispy and sizzling.

recipe_name_ar: كفتة الحاتي المشوية
description: Charcoal-grilled minced beef and lamb skewers seasoned with grated onion water, parsley, and traditional El-Hati spice blend.
cooking_instructions: Grate onions and squeeze through cheesecloth, reserving onion juice for shaping. Mix meat with onion pulp, minced lamb tail fat (leya), chopped parsley, starch or soaked bread, baking powder, and spices. Knead vigorously for 10 mins until sticky paste forms. Chill for 1 hour. Mold onto flat metal skewers using onion water. Grill over hot charcoal or cast iron skillet for 12-15 mins turning frequently.

recipe_name_ar: شوربة عدس اصفر مصرية
description: Heartwarming winter soup made from red lentils simmered with carrots, tomatoes, onions, garlic, and cumin, finished with golden vermicelli.
cooking_instructions: Rinse red lentils. Place in pot with water or broth, sliced carrots, tomato, onion, and garlic cloves. Simmer for 25 mins until vegetables are tender. Blend until silky smooth. In separate skillet, brown vermicelli in ghee, then stir into the soup with cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 5 mins until vermicelli is cooked. Serve with fresh lemon wedges and crispy baladi croutons.

recipe_name_ar: شكشوكة مصرية بالبيض والخضار
description: Eggs poached gently in a bubbling, spiced sauce of tomatoes, bell peppers, sautéed onions, garlic, and fresh herbs.
cooking_instructions: Heat olive oil in wide cast iron skillet. Sauté chopped onions and bell pepper until soft. Add minced garlic, cumin, paprika, and chili flakes. Pour in crushed tomatoes and tomato paste, simmering for 10 mins until sauce thickens. Make small wells in sauce with back of a spoon and crack whole eggs into wells. Cover and cook on low for 5-7 mins until egg whites are set and yolks remain runny. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley.

recipe_name_ar: فول مدمس اسكندراني بالطحينة والليمون
description: Slow-cooked fava beans tossed Alexandria-style with tahini, crushed garlic, chopped tomatoes, cumin, lemon juice, and pure olive oil.
cooking_instructions: Warm cooked fava beans in a small pot and mash lightly with fork. In a bowl, whisk tahini with warm water, lemon juice, crushed garlic, cumin, and salt until smooth. Stir tahini dressing into warm beans. Fold in diced fresh tomatoes, hot green peppers, and finely chopped parsley. Drizzle generously with virgin olive oil or hot flaxseed oil (zeit har) and serve with hot baladi bread.

recipe_name_ar: طعمية مصرية بالفول المدشوش والسمسم
description: Authentic Egyptian green patties made with soaked split dried fava beans, fresh leeks, coriander, dill, coated in sesame seeds and fried crispy.
cooking_instructions: Soak split dried fava beans in cold water for 12 hours. Drain completely. Grind beans in food processor with fresh leek, onion, garlic, fresh dill, cilantro, and parsley until fluffy pale green paste forms. Season with dry coriander, cumin, baking powder, and salt. Shape into round patties, coat generously with raw white sesame seeds, and deep fry in hot oil until deeply browned and crisp.

recipe_name_ar: مكرونة الفريدو بالدجاج والكريمة
description: Silky fettuccine pasta coated in rich butter, heavy cream, garlic, and parmesan cheese topped with tender seared chicken breast.
cooking_instructions: Boil fettuccine in salted water. Sauté sliced chicken breast in butter until golden. Add minced garlic, pour in heavy cooking cream and grated parmesan. Simmer until sauce coats the spoon. Toss pasta in sauce, garnish with chopped parsley and black pepper.

recipe_name_ar: لازانيا ايطالية كلاسيكية باللحم
description: Layered pasta sheets with rich slow-cooked beef bolognese sauce, creamy béchamel, and melted mozzarella and parmesan.
cooking_instructions: Layer flat lasagna noodles with rich slow-cooked beef bolognese sauce, creamy béchamel, and grated mozzarella and parmesan cheeses. Bake in 180C oven for 40 mins until bubbly and golden brown.

recipe_name_ar: بيتزا مارجريتا ايطالية
description: Neapolitan crust topped with seasoned tomato sauce, melted mozzarella slices, fresh basil leaves, and virgin olive oil.
cooking_instructions: Stretch pizza dough into round disc. Spread seasoned tomato sauce, top with mozzarella slices, fresh basil leaves, and a drizzle of olive oil. Bake at 250C for 10-12 mins.

recipe_name_ar: كاري دجاج بالارز البسمتي
description: Tender chicken cooked in an aromatic curry sauce infused with turmeric, cumin, ginger, garlic, and coconut milk.
cooking_instructions: Sauté onions, garlic, and ginger until fragrant. Add curry powder, turmeric, and cumin. Brown chicken chunks, add coconut milk or broth with diced potatoes. Simmer until chicken is tender and sauce is thick and aromatic.

recipe_name_ar: شوربة خضار مشكل صحية
description: Nourishing medley of fresh carrots, zucchini, potatoes, green peas, and celery simmered in flavorful herb broth.
cooking_instructions: Chop carrots, zucchini, potatoes, and green beans. Sauté onions in olive oil, add vegetables, pour in vegetable broth. Simmer for 25 mins until tender. Season with parsley, salt, and black pepper.
